The bug in `rich.text.Text.expand_tabs` was that it used the base style of the `Text` object when expanding tab characters into spaces, effectively discarding any styles applied via spans to the tab characters.

I fixed this by:
1. Identifying the style of the tab character by combining the `Text` object's base style with any styles from spans that cover the tab's position.
2. Applying this combined style to the expanded spaces.

This ensures that the formatting of tab characters is preserved when they are expanded into spaces.
